title: Quantitative evaluation of corneal epithelial edema after cataract surgery using corneal densitometry: a prospective study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: 'distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License', link http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; CC0 waiver for data made available in the article)

indication: Nuclear cataract of grade 2 or above (Results: posterior subcapsular opacity in 16, cortical opacity in 34 and mature cataract in 4 of 54 eyes); eyes with ocular surface disease (dry eye, superficial punctate keratopathy) excluded

groups.description: Phacoemulsification and aspiration through a 2.4-mm small incision (Infiniti, Alcon), single surgeon, topical anesthesia; 54 eyes of 34 patients, National Defense Medical College, July 2012 to October 2013; all surgeries uneventful (Results)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 1 row 'Central corneal thickness (μm)', column 'Preoperative'); Pentacam measurement before cataract surgery (Methods)
series.notes: Table 1 columns Preoperative and Postoperative Day1, Day3, Day7 (days converted as days/30.4375); mean ± SD in µm; corneal thickness by Pentacam rotating Scheimpflug camera (Methods); per-visit n not reported (54 eyes enrolled, no perioperative complications)

exclusions.what: Results text, Abstract and Fig. 3 'total corneal thickness at the corneal apex' before surgery and on days 1, 3 and 7
exclusions.reason: Values given in text and figure only (no table cell); Table 1 'Central corneal thickness' is cited instead

exclusions.what: Corneal densitometry readings (Fig. 1, Additional file 1, Results text)
Significance markers (* and **) in Table 1 cells
exclusions.reason: p-value annotations are not admissible values; only the leading mean of each cell is read

notes: Single cohort with standard phacoemulsification and no investigational arm: role control.

The Results text, Abstract and Fig. 3 report 'total corneal thickness at the corneal apex' with numbers that differ slightly from Table 1 'Central corneal thickness (μm)'; the protocol requires table cells, so Table 1 is cited. The reason for the difference is not stated.
54 eyes of 34 patients: both eyes of some patients are included, so eyes are not independent.
Statistics used Friedman's test with Bonferroni correction, but Table 1 reports mean ± SD.
